name: Specification conformance
summary: Check a deliverable against each stated requirement, requirement by requirement.

input.state: One requirement's text followed by the deliverable's relevant section.

conforms.instructions: The supplied section satisfies this requirement as written.
conforms.criteria: Answer yes only when the state supports it; otherwise no.

outputs.shape: conforms/violates per requirement; the caller aggregates the matrix

uncertainty.abstain: a section that does not reach the requirement answers violates - silence is non-conformance
uncertainty.refusal: a refused pair reports refused and stays in the review list

limits: Checks the supplied sections only - requirements needing whole-document judgment get the document split by the caller.
One requirement per judgment keeps failures attributable.

examples.api: POST /v1/systemone per item, or /v1/classify with items as inputs
examples.mcp: oak-mcp ask tool with the same envelope

evidence.label: unmeasured
evidence.note: Composition is verified over recorded answers by crates/gym/tests/recipes.rs; model-quality measurement runs through a gym suite and is pinned here only when it exists.
